title: Issue #6 PI30 proxy capture — commercial attribution corrected
summary: Private capture shows raw PI30 ASCII over a SmartESS DTU AT collector: QPI returns PI30, QPIRI returns a 28-field 6200 W / 48 V rating, and QPIGS returns a 21-field live telemetry frame. These wire facts remain valid, but the earlier attribution to Yingfa YF6.2K-2K-LEL-IF is withdrawn following the owner's Sumry clarification. The capture does not establish an exact Sumry commercial model or validate a separate 4.2 kW unit.
